name: China
description: Follow China, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Scientists discover 'D-rex', a giant fungus from Chinese forests whose unique lineage dates back 65 million years
changes.summary: Deep in the forests of Yunnan, China, scientists have discovered a "fungal giant" that challenges our understanding of how large fungi can become. The newly described species, Dianjunus rex, produces vertical fruiting bodies up to 50 cm (20 inches) high and weighing up to 2.2 kg (4.9 pounds)—the largest known within th.

changes.title: China sentences 3 people to death for running scam centers
changes.summary: Police discovered remains of victims bound with iron chains and with bullet holes in their skulls, state media said.

changes.title: U.S. restrictions on Chinese drones are hurting cash-strapped police departments
changes.summary: The U.S. government is trying to end the dominance of high-quality, low-cost drones made in China. But more restrictions mean higher costs for cash-strapped police forces that rely on those drones. (Image credit: Albert Yee for NPR).

changes.title: Ancient people relied on genetic variation already present in wild plants to domesticate crops like rice and corn
changes.summary: Oryza rufipogon is an ordinary-looking wild grass found today in parts of China, India and Southeast Asia. More than 8,000 years ago, people living in the Lower Yangtze Valley began cultivating it.

changes.title: A Reporter Returns to China to Find it Richer, but Also Highly Paranoid.
changes.summary: Returning to China after decades away, a correspondent finds bullet trains, dazzling skylines — and a surveillance state more paranoid and pervasive than ever.

changes.title: Spinach nanoparticles help failing rat hearts via 'borrowed photosynthesis'
changes.summary: A spinach leaf can turn light into chemical energy. A struggling heart cannot. Researchers in China have brought part of the leaf's energy-making machinery into rat heart cells to test whether borrowed photosynthesis could help an overworked heart.

changes.title: Trump's economic strategy resemble similar policies in East Asia
changes.summary: Much of the Trump administration's economic policy has been inspired by successful industrial policies successful in East Asia, including those of competitor, China. Will those policies work in the U.S.?

changes.title: Europe’s Trade Tensions With China Are Coming to a Head
changes.summary: The European Union is weighing tougher trade measures as negotiators prepare to meet Chinese officials in Beijing, with surging exports from China pressuring key industries in Europe.

changes.title: BMW’s iX4 SUV is a 428-mile defensive weapon against China’s EV takeover
changes.summary: While much of the automotive world sits dumbfounded as China gobbles up all its customers, BMW continues to roll out extremely well-crafted, technologically advanced electric vehicles that impress in both drive quality and price. The latest is the BMW iX4, a coupe-shaped SUV that puts a sportier spin on the automaker's.

changes.title: Coco Gauff decries "insane" amount of online racism after China match dispute
changes.summary: Coco Gauff said she received an "insane" amount of racist comments on social media following a controversial point in her China Open match against home player Sun Xinran.
